recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Handle future corrections to the EvidenceReport Composition profile in the EBM IG/package source, and handle future core Composition shape changes under their own Composition trackers rather than under FHIR-31867.
issue_request: FHIR-31867 was an Applied/Persuasive CDS change request asking FHIR core to stop recreating document organization in EvidenceReport, create an EvidenceReport profile on Composition using existing document capabilities, and deprecate the EvidenceReport resource.
initial_application: The issue was applied in stages. Commit 060d12b60c76 explicitly marked EvidenceReport deprecated/retired for J#31867. Commit 16c1c0945410 deleted source/evidencereport, and PR #3317 was merged as bd561abc6ca0 with the summary "J#31867 deleted EvidenceReport resource", removing active fhir.ini/resource-list references. Later commit b80d0e579cee added the current Clinical Reasoning page wording under FHIR-49687.
additional_context: Composition remains an active build resource while EvidenceReport is absent from source/fhir.ini. SD minutes for FHIR-31867 confirmed the plan to make needed Composition changes, create a Composition profile path, and retire EvidenceReport. The EBM IG package currently contains StructureDefinition/evidence-report based on Composition. Related Composition trackers FHIR-34158, FHIR-34159, and FHIR-32795 cover supporting status, attester, relatesTo, and additional-element work; FHIR-34159 and FHIR-32795 are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No core source edit is needed because the current build no longer publishes EvidenceReport as a resource, preserves active Composition support, and points to the external EBM Composition profile. Reintroducing a core EvidenceReport source or adding a redundant core profile would conflict with the current source organization.
source_changes: No source files changed; this was an empty audit commit.
